messages:
maya (AE): Customer wants to sign POC orderform today. They require KMS attestation + PO attached. Milestone billing: $20k POC fee, $5k activation. Can we route via DocuSign and include legal as reviewer? Need to close before EOD.

_tim (sales-ops): I uploaded orderform: https://drive.internal/po/poc-zenhealth. Template available: OrderForm-PO-Milestones-v2. Suggest sign order: AE -> Sales Manager -> Finance -> Customer Exec; legal as reviewer (post-sign).

_omar (finance): Finance needs billing contact, vendor tax ID, and PO number before invoicing. Attach PO to envelope and include custom field PO_NUMBER so AP can match. Net30 by default; Net45 needs director approval.

_lina (legal): We can provide a short KMS addendum for attachment. If buyer sends redlines referencing HSM vendor or SOC equivalence, route to infra (24-48h). Legal does not sign orderforms unless high-risk terms.

_esign-bot: Template Matched: "OrderForm-PO-Milestones-v2". API override example: { "templateId": "OF-PO-v2", "signerOrder": ["ae","sales_mgr","finance","customer_exec"] }. Link: https://docusign.internal/templates/OF-PO-v2.

_maya (AE): I'll get PO + attestation language from buyer. If they insist on legal signature we'll escalate.

_tim (sales-ops): Once PO arrives I'll prepare envelope, attach KMS addendum and PO, set PO_NUMBER field and send.

_omar (finance): Fine. Prefer split invoices per milestone but single orderform ok.

_lina (legal): Drafted KMS addendum: https://legal.internal/drafts/kms-addendum-zenhealth.docx. Minimal attestation stating HSM-backed keys in customer region.

_maya (AE): PO received. Tim - please send envelope.

_tim (sales-ops): Envelope sent with attachments and signer order. Notifying accounting.

_omar (finance): AP received PO copy and will process invoices after sign-off.

_lina (legal): Watching for any post-sign redlines.

_maya (AE): Thanks all. Closing thread once signed. :white_check_mark:
